publicCopy.long: WorldzParTyPlatform™ is becoming the digital home for Hodlerz Paradise™, DevCity™, InvestmentCity™, Worldz Launch Rooms™, Worldz Passport™, Worldz Academy / RECAP and Worldz Impact™. The next layer is WorldzTravelParTy™ 2026–2030: a proposed travelling community program combining music, builders, education, local business and practical action. Dubbo is the flagship homecoming concept. Artist invitations, visitor wallet packs and local-spend support remain proposals until accepted, approved and funded.
